components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action button with Electric Indigo fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #6366f1; color: #ffffff; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 12px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.25); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #4f46e5; }

components.name: Card Container
components.description: Obsidian dark container card with hairline glass border.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #141721; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px; color: #f8fafc; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); }

narrative.overview: Personal OS & CRM is an executive control room and autonomous factory balancing density with visual calm.
keyCharacteristics: Indigo primary focus with amber signals
Split typography: Plus Jakarta Sans and JetBrains Mono

rules.name: The Rarity of Amber Rule
rules.body: Amber is reserved for items requiring immediate human intervention.

rules.name: The Single Dark Canvas Rule
rules.body: All views and modals must anchor to #0b0c10 background and #0f1117/#141721 surfaces.

rules.name: The Telemetry Mono Rule
rules.body: All numbers, currency values, and terminal output must use JetBrains Mono.

dos: Do use JetBrains Mono for all currency amounts, deal values, lead counters, and times.
Do enforce internal scrolling on modal bodies while pinning header and action footers.
Do maintain responsive padding: p-4 on mobile scaling to p-6 on desktop.
donts: Don't use raw uncalibrated hex colors in component files.
Don't permit horizontal scrolling on any view or modal across breakpoints.
Don't allow fixed modal heights that clip action buttons on small screens.
